rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: apartments - a street row; residential street rule (runs of one species per block face, gaps at lamps and signs), thinned to 2 a face by the in-view limit (12 trees, 8 broadleaf within 60 m: the piece stands 6 times in a row). Yasin 19 Nov: no tree stays in a well, new trees by hand on grass only
written: 19 Nov 2026 (PC session, streets pass): picked by hand from the builder trees' spots, one by one
